fact: Chapter 7 is titled 'Creating The Right Atmosphere'
Every living thing needs a conducive atmosphere for development, and even plants need the right condition to grow if you want the best results or harvest
The THREE factors that make a conducive atmosphere for mental development are quietness, separation and keeping wise company

Creating a conducive atmosphere for development means creating an atmosphere conducive for divine inspiration, and these three factors enhance your speedy development in the school of mental excellence
Quietness is the first factor, and the practice of quietness enhances mental development
The Bible defines quietness as a virtue of great price, that is, it carries valuable treasures
1 Peter 3:4 is quoted: 'let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price'
1 Thessalonians 4:11 says 'And that ye study to be quiet, and to do your own business...'
Inspiration is the catalyst for unique intelligence, and it requires quietness
When Elijah was at the point of giving up he laid tired by the mouth of a cave, and there was an earthquake, a fire, and then a strong wind, but God was not there
It was in the midst of the still small voice that a new chapter was opened up to Elijah
Elijah was out on a suicide mission and wanted to die, but the virtue of quietness paid off for him in the midst of his despair, as God demonstrated a great drama on how to encounter inspiration
Quietness is in the sight of God a treasure of great price because it facilitates inspiration, which is a great asset in our quest for mental excellence
Jeremiah 9:23-24 is cited: 'Let not the mighty man glory in his wisdom, but let him that glory, glory in this, that he knows me'
Every outstanding insight has God's input, and God's input is contacted through inspiration
The practice of quietness is a requirement for mental development because the voice of the Lord always comes down in a still voice
Isaiah 30:21 is cited, that you will hear a voice behind you, so you have to be extra still
Separation is the second factor, and Proverbs 18:1 is its text: 'Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom'
Separation entails getting out of the crowd and multitude, and getting yourself to a corner alone
Every author will agree that every solid material he gets is delivered in solitary corners
The author once had a big problem and travelled to Accra, Ghana in order to be alone
On arrival in Accra he told the missionaries: no telephone calls, no personal contacts, no one comes around, he was not there for the church and would not preach or teach anywhere

One early morning he was up at the seashore, and after walking about two kilometres he needed to sit down, kept thinking there had to be a solution, picked his pen alone under a little canopy, and had showers from heaven
By the time he got back to Nigeria he was fully armed with what to do to deal with the problem and put everything back in place
At another time he needed to establish his stand on prosperity, not having enough proofs to convince the gainsayers, so he took off on a 3-day trip
He armed himself with some materials and separated himself with no meetings and no going out, and on the THIRD day the heavens came down
What he laid hold on that day, dated May 1981, is still with him as fresh as the day it was first delivered
Genesis 24:63 tells how Isaac separated himself and went out to meditate, which is how he became a unique farmer
Isaac got extraordinary insights on how to make things work in spite of famine
When the Bible said Isaac sowed in the land in Genesis 26:12 it was NOT that he gave offering; Isaac sowed practical seeds and reaped a bumper harvest, because he knew what to do to get it
Isaac understood the mystery of separation for mental prowess and dignity, and went out to meditate in the evening time, and as he lifted up his eyes, behold the camels were coming
Many need to take a trip outside their rooms since they cannot think well there, and should utilise the weekend to find the answer to a bugging issue
You cannot live in the midst of noise and make the most of this treasure called the mind

Bill Gates, called the computer giant, was one day busy in one corner engaged in serious mental exercise while his mother went looking everywhere for him, calling 'Bill! Bill! Where are you?' with no sound and no response
When Bill Gates' mother located him and asked what he was doing there, his response was 'I am thinking! Don't you think!'
Keeping wise company is the third factor, and Proverbs 13:20 is its text: 'He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed'
Having wise friends, walking with wise people and connecting with wise associates enhance your mental development
Wise company does not have to be there physically: you can make friends through materials like books and tapes, and make the authors and preachers your friends in absentia
Someone said 'You'll remain the same way you are today in five years, except for two things: the books you read and the people with whom you walk'
What you are doing while reading a book is sharing the opinions and thoughts of the author, rubbing minds with him
Every book you read is the author's thoughts in print, so when you read his material you are keeping company with him and in no time you will start thinking the same way
One way to determine who to associate with is to find out whether what the person is saying is profiting him or her or not
The Amplified Version of Job 32:8 reads 'But there is [a vital force] a spirit [of intelligence] in man, and the breath of the Almighty gives men understanding'
Your openness to divine inspiration is what determines how intelligent you become, and inspiration has no match in the school of intelligence
The chapter closes telling you it is time to switch off the noise and row in your environment so you can catch what God has in store for you
